mechanism.claim: During the completed liquid 13:00-21:00 UTC session, unusually strong positive one-minute USDJPY-to-next-minute-BTC correlation identifies yen-carry information leading crypto rather than merely moving alongside it. In a high-variation BTC regime, follow the completed USDJPY risk direction for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: sign of completed USDJPY session return; yen weakness is BTC long and yen strength is BTC short
mechanism.why_distinct: YLIRTR measures ordered cross-market lead transmission corr(USDJPY return[t], BTC return[t+1]). UJCVR used only an extreme USDJPY endpoint return and failed source concentration; dollar-factor and carry-concordance candidates use contemporaneous session endpoints or breadth. YLIRTR uses no prior event set, UJCVR threshold/control, crypto flow, funding, OI, premium, or implied volatility.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed pre-entry BTC 24-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one 21:05 UTC weekday macro-lead clock is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.session: aligned bars_polygon USDJPY and bars_binance BTCUSDT 1m rows with 13:00<=UTC time<21:00 on one weekday
features.session_valid: at least 450 distinct aligned minutes, first<=13:05, last>=20:55, finite positive coherent OHLC; no imputation
features.minute_returns: log(close/open) independently for each aligned completed minute
features.lead_correlation: Pearson correlation between USDJPY return[t] and BTC return[t+1] over ordered adjacent aligned minutes; finite positive variance required
features.lead_correlation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 252 prior valid weekday sessions, minimum 126, current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.fx_return: log(last observed USDJPY close/first observed USDJPY open), strict nonzero
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTC minute returns over the 24 hours ending at decision)
features.volatility_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 252 valid weekday decisions, minimum 126, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact weekday D 21:00 UTC after the FX session and BTC variation are complete
clock.reservation: fixed weekday decisions; global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_implied_vol: not signal inputs; exact funding only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: fixed ordered yen-to-BTC intraday lead transmission

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no correlation, rank, side, hold, clock, session, or subset repair.
